notes.title: Voin, the Doom meets Dark Souls RPG, expands with a chilling major update
notes.notes:
The first time I ever played Voin, I was instantly hooked. The first-person dark fantasy RPG deftly blends Dark Souls and Doom into something completely new, and is well worth playing if you haven't yet. On the one hand, Voin's got the methodical swordplay and exploration of Fromsoftware's best. On the other, it has id's fast-paced, brutal, and blood-pumping action that refuses to ever slow down. I adore Voin because it manages to jump between these states of being on the fly, turning it into a game unlike any other. Now, its next major update is here alongside a sale, making it the ideal time to dive in.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: New Tree of Talents and the Next Update Preview
notes.notes:
[h1]Lightnings,[/h1]

I’ve been cooking.

I’m excited to share that [i][b]VOIN: Permafrost[/b][/i] - a massive new update - is scheduled to be released in June. Watch the new devlog below to see what’s coming next.

But I can’t leave you waiting that long without something new, can I? 

[h2]The Reflected Tree of Talents[/h2]
Step into the Hall of Reflections in the Amarict and behold the newest addition to that sacred room - [b]The Reflected Tree of Talents.[/b] 

The tree already awaits you in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616621/65b5a993dc6ca1eb775b7f7772268f43ae178107.jpg[/img]
This Tree reflects your inner soul, the very essence of what makes you VOIN.
It represents all current and future skills you unlock and acquire throughout your runs. 

Locate and obtain the Soulfruits during your runs, and bring them to the Tree. That way, you can unlock new, powerful passive skills to help on your mission to cleanse this world.
 
You can assign and reassign these skills directly on the Reflected Tree of Talents while visiting the Hall of Reflections. You will unlock new skill slots as you level up. 

[h2]Watch the new devlog[/h2]
[previewyoutube=JbLWQ32UlPA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The complete list of changes in Version 0.2.9[/h2]
[b]Note:[/b] ⚡ indicates changes inspired by community!

[b]Additions 🆕[/b]
[list]
[*] The Tree of Talents. Explore the world and find 24 Soulfruits, which you can attach to the Tree of Talents inside the Hall of Reflection to gain various passive bonuses!
[*] ⚡ Automatic inventory sorting by type (similar items are grouped).
[*] ⚡ Items can be added to 'Favorite' list. Favorite items always stay on top of the inventory and can't be dropped.
[*] ⚡ Sky Nodes were added to the Lost City of Omixeer dungeon under the White Mountain Citadel.
[/list]
[b]Changes 🔄[/b]
[list]
[*] The leveling experience has been remade—kill monsters, gain experience, and level up as soon as you have enough experience.
[*] ⚡ Unique items (such as The Snakes, Constellations, The Mace of Spirits Repose) can now drop as loot after you pick them up for the first time.
[*] The Field of View for the character’s hands is calculated independently from the camera’s.
[/list]
[b]Rebalances ⚖️[/b]
[list]
[*] Veilrender’s enchantment, Avatar of Undeath, now ticks every 1.2–1.0 seconds instead of 0.5–0.35 seconds.
[*] In order to freeze an enemy, 12 stacks of Freezing are required instead of 11.
[*] Shattering frozen enemies does 5x physical damage to all enemies nearby instead of 6x damage.
[*] Alum Heart’s max stacks have been reduced to 3, and the time it takes to restore charges has been doubled. The timer also resets upon losing temporary or permanent heart charges.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes 🐛[/b]
[list]
[*] All enchantments calculate their damage correctly now.
[*] Improved performance of various aspects of enemies (CPU and GPU related).
[*] Optimized the Frostfangs ice pillars. The game won't lag anymore when a lot of them are spawned simultaneously.
[/list]
[b]Engine changes 🚗[/b]
[list]
[*] Converted the project to Unreal Engine 5.5. Let me know if you notice any performance issues.
[/list]

Until next time,
~ Nikita

notes.title: Voin, the RPG that blends Doom and Dark Souls, just got a massive new update
notes.notes:
Slaying grotesque enemies, achingly beautiful and powerful melee weapons, and dark fantasy worlds - just some of the core ingredients for any good FromSoftware RPG. But what if Dark Souls went first-person, picked up the pace a bit, and incorporated flashes of Doom's hellish, metal aesthetic? Well, you'd get something that looks a lot like Voin. Made by a single developer, this already ambitious RPG just got even bigger and better with its first major content update that adds a new dungeon and fresh foes to the game.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Thunderborn Update is Available Now
notes.notes:
[h1]Lightnings,
The Thunderborn Update (Version 0.2.0) is here.[/h1]

The skies flash with fury, and the world trembles. A storm is rising, and only the [i][b]Thunderborn[/b][/i] can stand against the abominations and spectral horrors summoned by [i]HER[/i] will. Will you answer the call?

This is the first of several major updates, bringing long-planned additions to the game, and many of those that were shaped by your feedback. Some arrived in early February ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2464530/view/520830071182724676]read the patch notes here[/url]), but now, I am thrilled to unveil everything that remained behind the veil.

[previewyoutube=VipSSHgTTj4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New MASSIVE Dungeon Awaits[/h1]
Descend into the abyss beneath the Cathedral of Veiled Lament. Explore breathtaking yet deadly vistas and face the guardian of Hadracon’s Scroll—[i][b]Nomme, The Summoner of Tears[/b][/i].

I have altered the location of this scroll to make progression feel more natural and introduce greater challenges on the path to unlocking new zones. To open the gates of Hadracon’s Citadel, you must now first overcome its keeper.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WhASfbo.gif[/img]

[h1]New Enemies to Slay[/h1]
[b]The dead rise[/b] at [i]HER[/i] call. Put them to rest once more.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Pxzi100.gif[/img]

[i]HER[/i] will has stirred [b]ancient titans of fire and ash[/b]. Their purpose is destruction. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QdMDExP.gif[/img]

[i]HER[/i] twisted craft has led to [b]monstrous mutation[/b]s, creatures grown beyond reason.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0iXYi4b.gif[/img]

[h1]New HIGH-LEVEL Arena to Test Your Might[/h1]
Deep in the dungeon lies the [b]Circle of the Damned[/b]. Aid the ancient king Sedogor to purge the arena of filth and claim a weapon so powerful it tears through reality itself. Nothing shall stand between you and the cleansing.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PA3uVES.gif[/img]

[h1]And Much More:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New weapons and items
[*] Rich chests with greater rewards
[*] An optional boss with a unique reward
[*] Gameplay improvements and fixes
[/list]

The path to cleansing has only just begun. More challenges, expanded world activities, and even greater battles lie ahead. [b]A chilling horror is coming[/b].

To everyone who has already answered the call—I cannot thank you enough for your support. Join us in [url=https://discord.gg/aG72maUUnA]our sacred Discord[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464530/VOIN/#app_reviews_hash]leave your mark with a Steam review[/url], and prepare for what’s to come.

Full patch notes for the Thunderborn Update:
[b]Note:[/b] ⚡ indicates changes inspired by the community!

[h1]Additions 🆕[/h1]
[list]
[*] Completely new, [b]massive dungeon[/b] underneath the Cathedral of Veiled Lament (the first location).
[*] [b]Arena[/b] quest where only the mightiest will prevail... with a reward fit for a Vindicator.
[*] New optional [b]boss fight[/b].
[*] [b]5 completely new enemy types[/b] for the two new factions of monsters: [b]undead[/b] and [b]creatures[/b].
[*] ⚡ Any chest (including secret ones) can now be [b]Rich[/b], with a lot more ichor and items of at least Elder (blue) quality. The chance of a chest being Rich scales with difficulty aspects.
[*] [b]Powerful new weapons and multiple items across all types[/b] (with the majority of them suggested by the community!). This includes 2 unique weapons, that drop from the new optional boss and as a reward for completing the Arena.
[/list]
[h1]Rebalances ⚖️[/h1]
[list]
[*] ⚡ Amount of ichor received per each individual item was reduced.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes 🐛[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bosses health now scales properly with the Toughness difficulty modifier (it was capped at 10k before). Expect major differences in the amount of health on higher difficulties. You’ve been warned.
[*] Fixed an issue where meteors summoned by the Dragonhead Necklace were not dealing damage.

notes.title: Dark fantasy RPG Voin is like Doom with swords, and its first big update is here
notes.notes:
I've already called Voin a 'boomer slasher,' and with the benefit of hindsight, I think it fits the game quite well. On the one hand, it's got the pace, frantic combat, and action of a shooter like Doom, but on the other, it has the methodical swordplay of the soulslike genre. You've also got to explore, find upgrades, and hone your skills while hacking your enemies to pieces, and all of this comes together into a Steam Early Access experience with loads of promise. Solo developer Nikita Sozidar has just released Voin's first major update, too, and it makes everything better.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Update #1 (Version 0.1.5) is now live
notes.notes:
[h2]Lightnings,
Update #1 (Version 0.1.5) is now live.[/h2]

I have spent most of the time refactoring several systems under the hood to make it easier to add future content, so this update will be light on content, but I am almost done with engine-related work, so further progress will be faster and much more noticeable.

Behold the patch notes of the Update #1 (Version 0.1.5) below.
[b]Note: [/b]⚡ indicates changes inspired by the community!

[h2]Additions 🆕[/h2]
[list]
[*] The difficulty level affecting the chance of encountering [b]Brutal and Terrifying enemies[/b] (Enormity) has been implemented and can now be adjusted.
[*] Brutal and Terrifying versions of enemies [b]inherit random abilities[/b], like the ability to conjure and throw boulders or the ability to spawn shadow clones.
[*] Choosing the level to explore [b]can now be done by selecting the location[/b] on a giant planet's miniature at Amarict.
[*] [b]New monster type: Magma Golem[/b], a menacing opponent that can be encountered deep underground.
[*] ⚡ Added an option to automatically pick up items based on their rarity.
[*] ⚡ Added a toggle for subtitles.
[*] ⚡ Added a toggle for HUD crosshair.
[*] ⚡ Added options to scale HUD, Damage Numbers, Enemy Healthbars, Subtitles and Crosshair.
[*] ⚡ Added a slider to control the camera's side tilt power.
[*] Added a slider to control the game's speed.
[/list]
[h2]Changes 🔄[/h2]
[list]
[*] ⚡ Difficulty levels now affect the amount of received Ichor and the chance of encountering higher rarity items.
[*] Most status effects decrease faster depending on the number of stacks.
[*] Calling the portal back to Amarict now requires holding down the input key, instead of triggering instantly, to avoid situations where you didn't mean to do that.
[*] ⚡Added unique visual and sound effects for Black Razor's Sudden Death ability.
[/list]
[h2]Rebalances ⚖️[/h2]
[list]
[*] ⚡ Bonus to the amount of received Ichor is added to the list of possible Satiety enchants.
[*] ⚡ The speed at which Satiety level drops was decreased by half.
[*] The luck attribute was rebalanced to maintain Primeval items being relatively rare, even at high luck. For example, with 100 luck roughly 10% of dropped items will be Primeval, with 200 luck — 20%, etc.
[*] Player levels and Ichor requirements to level up were rebalanced to prepare for the upcoming addition of talent trees. The cost of levelling up now scales up to level 100, which is the new level cap.
[*] Each level-up now increases all characters' damage output by 3% instead of 5%.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes 🐛[/h2]
[list]
[*] The fatal crash caused by Hags summoning monsters has been fixed (I think). Let me know if you are still experiencing this.
[*] Lags and hitches in Necrosever are completely eliminated.
[*] Monster spawners now save and load all data properly; spawns are consistent between level changes.
[*] Fleshsmith Rogorog's voice lines are now affected by the volume settings.
[/list]
[h2]Engine changes 🚗[/h2]
[i](the majority of development time was spent here)[/i]
[list]
[*] The way monsters are defined in-engine and the way spawners work were completely remade to make it much easier and quicker to add new content in future.
[*] The game's flow system has also been completely remade to make it easier to add quests, dialogues, achievements and other features in the future. It is currently being used for the tutorial sequence.
[/list]
Even though this is not the [b]"Thunderborn"[/b] update mentioned in the roadmap, it contains the first batch of its content: new difficulty settings (and rewards), enemy affixes, enemy type, bug fixes, and rebalances.

Thank you for sharing your wisdom in the comments sections, Steam forums, and on [url=https://discord.com/invite/aG72maUUnA]our sacred Discord server[/url]. Please keep on sharing your feedback and let the cleansing continue.

notes.title: First promo and Update details
notes.notes:
[h2]Lightnings,[/h2]

I am endlessly grateful to everyone who has played and supported VOIN so far. Your feedback, reviews, and enthusiasm have been invaluable in shaping the game. 

To celebrate this journey, VOIN is now available at a discounted price for the very first time! If you’ve been waiting to join the fray, now is the perfect moment with 20% off. And for those already cleansing the darkness—thank you for being here from the start. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616621/3fb5abf338982cfa88f22112c7930318a52477dc.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464530/VOIN/

[h2]But that’s not all! I’m delighted to give you a sneak peek of the first update:[/h2]

[h3]Revamped Level Selection[/h3]
Explore the world like never before with a new sprawling planetary map. Pick your destination by selecting a zone directly on a world map and the portal will lead you directly to that location.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/szQ6Eab.gif[/img]

[h3]New Difficulty Modifier[/h3]
The third skull on the altar has been activated. It introduces the fiercest challenge yet, putting you against elite monster variants with unique affixes. Here’s an example of a Vanguard using [i]two new abilities[/i] - [b]side dashes[/b] and [b]shadow clones[/b], that are invincible to your attack, but will eventually despawn. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6pEzDJU.gif[/img]

[h3]New Enemy[/h3]
Beware the Lava Golem, a molten force of nature that will test your skill and strategy in battle.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/N2Hmnw1.gif[/img]

The update is planned for release by the end of this week. We're finalizing the localization for all supported languages to ensure everyone can dive in seamlessly.

Thank you again for walking this path with me. Your support means everything. Let’s continue to shape this world together. 

Until then, keep the cleansing going!

notes.notes:
For the Steam Next Fest where VOIN is present the demo has been updated with several improvements and fixes:

[list]
[*] The tutorial has been simplified and streamlined, making it more coherent and faster to complete.
[*] Corrupted items have been revamped. They no longer apply Weakness. Instead, their properties remain hidden until you cleanse them. Deckard Cain is now a bell.
[*] IMPORTANT! :loudspeaker: We've fixed numerous bugs, including issues with key bindings. To do this, we had to rewrite all key-input logic. Unfortunately, this means old save files will no longer be compatible, and you'll need to start fresh. I understand this can be frustrating, and I promise that save resets will only happen again if absolutely necessary.

[/list]
If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please share them in the community section, thank you!
